podcast.body: Recorded in 1971 and released in April 1972, this song is described as a "cult favorite" that would still sound current today, showcasing the band's ahead-of-its-time musical sensibilities. "A song like this would not sound out of place today, but it was recorded in 1971 and released in April 1972. This is Big Star with 13."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Peaked Too Soon - Bands That Were Ahead of Their Time

podcast.body: This song was used as a sample during a discussion about Big Star, highlighting their influence on Power Pop bands. The band, despite not selling many records, received a Grammy for Best Liner Notes in 2013 for their "Keep an Eye on the Sky" box set. "Here's a sample of Big Star, me and why not? It's called 13."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
